context.app_name: Highlander Events — UCR Club Events App
decisions: React Native + Expo with Expo Router (file-based routing)
Express + pg driver for backend (NOT TypeScript, plain JS)
Railway PostgreSQL for database — already migrated + seeded
UCR brand colors: Blue #2D6CC0, Gold #F1AB00, dark mode default
TikTok-style vertical feed with FlatList pagingEnabled + snapToInterval
Feed algorithm: followed clubs first, then by recency + popularity
API runs on port 3001, mobile uses 10.0.2.2:3001 for Android emulator

phase1_status.backend_api: COMPLETE — 23+ endpoints, 6 route groups, all working
phase1_status.database: COMPLETE — 9 tables migrated + seeded on Railway (3 clubs, 10 events, 3 users)
phase1_status.mobile_scaffold: COMPLETE — 8 screens created, Expo export verified (18 routes, 0 errors)
phase1_status.auth: COMPLETE — login → code → verify → JWT tested and working

task.description: Wire up the mobile screens to the live backend API and polish the core user experience. The screens are already built but need end-to-end testing with real data. Focus on making the feed smooth, RSVP responsive, and search functional.

subtasks.title: Wire Feed to Live API
subtasks.description: The feed screen (apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/index.tsx) already calls users.feed() and eventsApi.happeningNow(). Verify it renders real data from the API. Fix any rendering issues with the EventCard component. Ensure the vertical snapping is smooth at 60fps.

subtasks.title: Test RSVP End-to-End
subtasks.description: RSVP toggle already calls eventsApi.rsvp(). Verify: tapping RSVP updates count immediately, the heart animation plays, max_attendees blocking works (API returns 409 when full). Test on both feed cards and event detail screen.

subtasks.title: Test Club Follow + Personalized Feed
subtasks.description: Follow toggle calls clubsApi.follow(). Verify: following a club moves its events to the top of the feed. Test the club detail screen renders upcoming events. Verify the follow button state persists.

subtasks.title: Wire Filters + Search
subtasks.description: Search screen calls searchApi.query(). Verify: keyword search returns events + clubs. Category pills filter correctly. Calendar screen loads events for selected date. Fix any TypeScript issues.

subtasks.title: Wire Friend Activity
subtasks.description: Profile screen shows friends list. Verify: adding a friend by email works (usersApi.addFriend). 'X friends going' badge shows on feed cards (friends_going field). Friend activity screen loads.

acceptance_criteria: Feed loads real events from API and displays in vertical snapping cards
RSVP toggle works end-to-end with animated feedback
Club follow/unfollow persists and affects feed ordering
Search returns matching events and clubs
Calendar shows events for the selected date
Friend activity shows 'X friends going' on cards
constraints: Do NOT modify backend API routes — they are tested and working
Keep the UCR dark theme (Colors.ts) — do not change brand colors
Keep the TikTok-style vertical feed — do not change to horizontal/grid
All API calls go through services/api.ts — do not use raw fetch
Follow the existing file structure (Expo Router file-based routing)

expected_outputs: Updated mobile screens with working API integration
Any bug fixes to components or API calls
Screenshot or Expo log confirming feed renders real data
